name: codex-windows-toast
description: Show an actionable Windows toast when a Codex CLI turn ends.

interface.shortDescription: Notify when Codex finishes and return to its window group.
interface.longDescription: Sends a native Windows toast after the main Codex CLI agent finishes a turn, with an optional action that returns to the window or Windows 11 Snap Group where the prompt was submitted.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether Codex Windows Toast is installed correctly.
